Blue [[Reef Lurker]]s are potential [[Animal companion|charmable pets]] that can be found in the eastern region of [[Cantha]], in the [[Luxon]] territories of [[the Jade Sea]]. They are a common pet used by [[Luxon Ranger]]s and are also the totem animal of one of the Luxon clans, [[the Crab]]. They are closely related to the red [[Lurker]]s found on the southeastern fringes of [[Kaineng City]].

==Notes==
*They walk sideways
*During their idle animation, they use their pincers to feed.
*When a Reef Lurker evolves, its default name is changed to "<evolution prefix> Crab".
*A level 15 [[Elder]] Crab spawns in [[Boreas Seabed (explorable area)|Boreas Seabed]], northeast of [[Zos Shivros Channel (outpost)|Zos Shivros Channel]], ready to be charmed by [[Milodestus the Wrangler]]. Flagging [[hero]]es, it is possible  to kill/interrupt the mob there, allowing the player to charm the pet.
*Reef Lurkers deal [[slashing damage]].
*[[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Cantha)''

==Trivia==
*Their left pincers are bigger than their right ones, like [[W:Fiddler crab|fiddler crabs]]. The shape of the shell is similar too.
*Before being introduced in Factions, Reef Lurkers were already in development during alpha testing of Prophecies in 2004, as mentioned by an alpha tester in the Photics e-zine issue #3<ref>https://photics.com/issues/issue03.pdf</ref> of March 2004.
